name: INVENTORY_CORRECTION_BULK_V1
correction_classification: false_event: accepted event did not occur; append exact targeted suppression/correction where contract permits
relationship_correction: exact Inventory relation was wrong; close/supersede that relation and append reviewed replacement without changing participating identities
identifier_alias_correction: preserve entity and former SR7/C10 alias; establish new current alias
material_submitted_fault_tag_correction: never edit submitted membership; require replacement Fault Tag
genuine_later_development: not a correction; route to normal lifecycle command such as rejection/resend
bulk_preflight: load exact target projections/dependencies under stable snapshot
build canonical fingerprint from action kind + ordered exact eligible target identities/revisions/material dependencies
display every partition; never silently skip
bulk_commit: inside one UnitOfWork re-read every intended eligible target
any stale/incompatible intended target aborts whole accepted scope
insert one command receipt and one batch identity
append one independent lifecycle event/result for each target
audit batch plus per-target result references and commit atomically
correction_after_bulk: A later correction targets one event/relationship identity from the batch and does not reverse unaffected batch members.
hard_delete: dependency preview is exact and fail-closed; only genuinely untouched draft-like records may be physically removed, allocator/audit/history rules still survive.
